\chapter{Three-Field No-Model Checkpoint}
\label{ch:pa-form-three-checkpoint}
\hlchaptermodality{23}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can use three remembered closed-bank cues to fill the known language, residence, and work fields without romanization or a copyable answer.}

The learner fills three requested fields with no model after selection, spelling, spacing, placement, and mixed repair have each received a separate bounded pass.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[three-field selection repair]{Repair only selection}

\label{lesson:PA-W06-selection-repair}



\begin{quote}
The language bank still uses A — \textbf{\pa{ਪੰਜਾਬੀ}}, B — \textbf{\pa{ਹਿੰਦੀ}}. Read it once, then cover it.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — one selection repair}
The cue is B, but the line says \textbf{\pa{ਭਾਸ਼ਾ}: \pa{ਪੰਜਾਬੀ}}. Replace only the selected value. The label, colon, space, and placement remain unchanged.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Name the repaired dimension: selection. Do not judge letter shape or spacing in this pass.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The next pass keeps selection fixed and inspects spelling only.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[three-field spelling repair]{Repair only spelling}

\label{lesson:PA-W06-spelling-repair}



\begin{quote}
Read \textbf{\pa{ਸ਼ਹਿਰ}} once. Touch \textbf{\pa{ਸ਼}}, then \textbf{\pa{ਹਿ}}, then \textbf{\pa{ਰ}}. Cover the model.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — one spelling repair}
The selected residence value is correct, but \textbf{\pa{ਰਿਹਾਇਸ਼}: \pa{ਸ਼ਹਰ}} is missing one spelling piece. Repair only the value. Keep its selection, line, label, colon, and space.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Reveal \textbf{\pa{ਸ਼ਹਿਰ}} and compare one piece at a time. Do not change another line.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The next pass ignores spelling and repairs one boundary.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[three-field spacing repair]{Repair only spacing}

\label{lesson:PA-W06-spacing-repair}



\begin{quote}
Compare \textbf{\pa{ਕੰਮ}:\pa{ਖੇਤੀ}} with \textbf{\pa{ਕੰਮ}: \pa{ਖੇਤੀ}}. Every letter and the selected value match.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — one boundary repair}
Rewrite \textbf{\pa{ਕੰਮ}:\pa{ਖੇਤੀ}} with one clear space after the colon. Change nothing else.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Point to the repaired boundary. Ignore selection, spelling, and line order.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The next pass keeps every value intact and repairs its line placement.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[three-field placement repair]{Repair only placement}

\label{lesson:PA-W06-placement-repair}



\begin{quote}
Both values are correctly selected and spelled, but these lines are crossed:

\begin{quote}
\textbf{\pa{ਭਾਸ਼ਾ}: \pa{ਖੇਤੀ}}
\end{quote}

>

\begin{quote}
\textbf{\pa{ਕੰਮ}: \pa{ਪੰਜਾਬੀ}}
\end{quote}
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — move, do not respell}
Rewrite the two values on their matching fields. Preserve every letter and both spaces.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say “placement” after the repair. Selection and spelling were already correct.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
All four dimensions have now received their own repair pass.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[three-field one-dimension repair]{Repair one dimension, then stop}

\label{lesson:PA-W06-mixed-repair}



\begin{quote}
Name the four passes in order: selection, spelling, spacing, placement.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — one mixed repair}
Inspect these otherwise correct lines:

\begin{quote}
\textbf{\pa{ਭਾਸ਼ਾ}: \pa{ਪੰਜਾਬੀ}}
\end{quote}

>

\begin{quote}
\textbf{\pa{ਰਿਹਾਇਸ਼}:\pa{ਸ਼ਹਿਰ}}
\end{quote}

>

\begin{quote}
\textbf{\pa{ਕੰਮ}: \pa{ਖੇਤੀ}}
\end{quote}

The cue selections, spellings, and placements are correct. Repair the first differing dimension, then stop.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say which pass found the difference. Do not recopy the two unchanged lines.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The next lesson asks for fresh writing, not correction of a visible answer.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[three-field no-model checkpoint]{Three-field no-model checkpoint}

\label{lesson:PA-W06-three-field-no-model}



\begin{quote}
Close every field lesson. There is no value bank, support-language label, romanization, or copyable answer below.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — independent controlled choice}
Complete the three requested fields:

\begin{quote}
A — \textbf{\pa{ਭਾਸ਼ਾ}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_}
\end{quote}

>

\begin{quote}
B — \textbf{\pa{ਰਿਹਾਇਸ਼}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_}
\end{quote}

>

\begin{quote}
A — \textbf{\pa{ਕੰਮ}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_}
\end{quote}

Use the three remembered closed banks. Finish all three attempts before reopening any earlier lesson.

\subsection*{Your turn — separate repair passes}
After writing, compare selection, spelling, spacing, then placement. Repair only the first differing dimension and stop.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
This checkpoint integrates only language, residence, and work. It does not claim the later six-field form is complete.
\end{tcolorbox}
